title: The Ledger of Hollow Creek
setting_summary: A drought-stricken river valley where beavers, otters, herons, and field mice share a single dwindling reservoir behind an aging dam. The Warden, an ancient heron, controls the water gauge and rations each species' share by a ledger only he can read, while the dry season tightens every day. Scarcity and surveillance turn neighbor against neighbor as whispers of a fairer accounting spread through the reeds.
